refs.text_en: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem; and his mother's name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah, from Libnah.

verses.text_gb: 西底家行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，是照约雅敬一切所行的。
verses.text_big5: 西底家行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，是照約雅敬一切所行的。
verses.text_en: And he did what was evil in the sight of Jehovah, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
verses.text_gb_plain: 西底家行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，是照约雅敬一切所行的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 西底家行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，是照約雅敬一切所行的。

verses.text_gb: 这些事临到耶路撒冷和犹大，是因耶和华的怒气发作，直到祂将人民从自己面前赶出。后来西底家背叛了巴比伦王。
verses.text_big5: 這些事臨到耶路撒冷和猶大，是因耶和華的怒氣發作，直到祂將人民從自己面前趕出。後來西底家背叛了巴比倫王。
verses.text_en: For it was through the anger of Jehovah that this came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah until He cast them out from His presence. And Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
verses.text_gb_plain: 这些事临到耶路撒冷和犹大，是因耶和华的怒气发作，直到祂将人民从自己面前赶出。后来西底家背叛了巴比伦王。
verses.text_big5_plain: 這些事臨到耶路撒冷和猶大，是因耶和華的怒氣發作，直到祂將人民從自己面前趕出。後來西底家背叛了巴比倫王。

verses.text_gb: 他[Cra]作王第九年十月初十日，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒率领全军来攻击耶路撒冷，对城安营，四围筑垒攻城。
verses.text_big5: 他[Cra]作王第九年十月初十日，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒率領全軍來攻擊耶路撒冷，對城安營，四圍築壘攻城。
verses.text_en: And in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, on the tenth of the month, Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon came, he and his whole army, against Jerusalem and encamped against it; and they built a siege wall against it all around.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他作王第九年十月初十日，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒率领全军来攻击耶路撒冷，对城安营，四围筑垒攻城。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他作王第九年十月初十日，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒率領全軍來攻擊耶路撒冷，對城安營，四圍築壘攻城。

refs.text_gb: 西底家作王第九年十月初十日，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒率领全军来攻击耶路撒冷，对城安营，四围筑垒攻城。
refs.text_big5: 西底家作王第九年十月初十日，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒率領全軍來攻擊耶路撒冷，對城安營，四圍築壘攻城。
refs.text_en: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon came, he and his whole army, against Jerusalem and encamped against it; and they built a siege wall against it all around.

refs.text_gb: 于是城被围困，直到西底家王十一年。
refs.text_big5: 於是城被圍困，直到西底家王十一年。
refs.text_en: So the city came under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

refs.text_gb: 四月初九日，城里饥荒严重，甚至那地的百姓都没有粮食。
refs.text_big5: 四月初九日，城裏饑荒嚴重，甚至那地的百姓都沒有糧食。
refs.text_en: On the ninth day of the fourth month, the famine was so severe within the city that there was no food for the people of the land.

refs.text_gb: 城被攻破，一切兵丁就在夜间从靠近王园两城墙之间的门，出城逃跑；迦勒底人正在四围攻城，王沿着通往亚拉巴的路逃去。
refs.text_big5: 城被攻破，一切兵丁就在夜間從靠近王園兩城牆之間的門，出城逃跑；迦勒底人正在四圍攻城，王沿著通往亞拉巴的路逃去。
refs.text_en: Then the city was breached, and all the men of war fled by night by way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king's garden, while the Chaldeans were all around the city; and the king went on the way toward the Arabah.

refs.text_gb: 迦勒底人的军队追赶王，在耶利哥的平原追上他；他的全军都离开他四散了。
refs.text_big5: 迦勒底人的軍隊追趕王，在耶利哥的平原追上他；他的全軍都離開他四散了。
refs.text_en: And the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and they overtook him in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

refs.text_gb: 迦勒底人拿住王，带他到在利比拉的巴比伦王那里审判他。
refs.text_big5: 迦勒底人拿住王，帶他到在利比拉的巴比倫王那裏審判他。
refs.text_en: And they seized the king and brought him up to the king of Babylon at Riblah, and they pronounced judgment upon him.

refs.text_gb: 他们在西底家眼前杀了他的众子，并且剜了西底家的眼睛，用铜链锁着他，带到巴比伦去。
refs.text_big5: 他們在西底家眼前殺了他的眾子，並且剜了西底家的眼睛，用銅鍊鎖著他，帶到巴比倫去。
refs.text_en: And they slaughtered Zedekiah's sons before his eyes then put out Zedekiah's eyes and bound him with bronze fetters and brought him to Babylon.

refs.text_gb: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒十九年五月初七日，巴比伦王的臣仆，护卫长尼布撒拉旦来到耶路撒冷，
refs.text_big5: 巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒十九年五月初七日，巴比倫王的臣僕，護衛長尼布撒拉旦來到耶路撒冷，
refs.text_en: In the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month (this was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon), Nebuzaradan, the captain of the bodyguard, the servant of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

refs.text_gb: 焚烧耶和华的殿和王宫，并耶路撒冷的一切房屋；每一大幢的房屋，他都用火焚烧了。
refs.text_big5: 焚燒耶和華的殿和王宮，並耶路撒冷的一切房屋；每一大幢的房屋，他都用火焚燒了。
refs.text_en: And he burned the house of Jehovah and the king's house and all the houses of Jerusalem, and every large house he burned with fire.

refs.text_gb: 跟从护卫长的迦勒底人全军，就拆毁耶路撒冷四围的城墙。
refs.text_big5: 跟從護衛長的迦勒底人全軍，就拆毀耶路撒冷四圍的城牆。
refs.text_en: And all the army of the Chaldeans who were with the captain of the bodyguard broke down the walls around Jerusalem.

refs.text_gb: 那时护卫长尼布撒拉旦将城里所剩下的百姓，并已经投降巴比伦王的人，以及所剩下的群众，都迁徙去了。
refs.text_big5: 那時護衛長尼布撒拉旦將城裏所剩下的百姓，並已經投降巴比倫王的人，以及所剩下的群眾，都遷徙去了。
refs.text_en: And the rest of the people who were left in the city and the deserters who deserted to the king of Babylon and the rest of the multitude, Nebuzaradan the captain of the bodyguard carried away into exile.

refs.text_gb: 但护卫长留下那地一些最穷的人，使他们修理葡萄园，耕种田地。
refs.text_big5: 但護衛長留下那地一些最窮的人，使他們修理葡萄園，耕種田地。
refs.text_en: But the captain of the bodyguard left some of the poorest of the land to be vinedressers and field workers.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华殿的铜柱，并耶和华殿的盆座和铜海，迦勒底人都打碎了，将那些铜运到巴比伦去了。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華殿的銅柱，並耶和華殿的盆座和銅海，迦勒底人都打碎了，將那些銅運到巴比倫去了。
refs.text_en: And the Chaldeans broke in pieces the bronze pillars, which were in the house of Jehovah, and the bases and the bronze sea, which were in the house of Jehovah. And they carried their bronze to Babylon.

refs.text_gb: 他们又把锅、铲、灯剪、调羹、并供职用的一切铜器，都带去了。
refs.text_big5: 他們又把鍋、鏟、燈剪、調羹、並供職用的一切銅器，都帶去了。
refs.text_en: And they took away the pots and the shovels and the snuffers and the cups and all the bronze vessels with which they ministered.

refs.text_gb: 火盆和碗，无论金的银的，护卫长也都带去了。
refs.text_big5: 火盆和碗，無論金的銀的，護衛長也都帶去了。
refs.text_en: And the captain of the bodyguard took away the firepans and the bowls: that which was of gold, for its gold, and that which was of silver, for its silver.

refs.text_en: As for the two pillars, the one sea, and the bases which Solomon had made for the house of Jehovah, the bronze of all these vessels was beyond weight.

refs.text_gb: 这一根柱子高十八肘，柱上有铜的柱顶，高三肘；柱顶的周围有网子和石榴，都是铜的；那一根柱子，照此一样，也有网子。

refs.text_en: The height of one pillar was eighteen cubits, and a bronze capital was upon it; and the height of the capital was three cubits; and a network and pomegranates were upon the capital all around, all of bronze; and the second pillar was like these with a network.

refs.text_en: And from the city he took one eunuch, who was overseer of the men of war, and five men from the king's inner circle who were found in the city, and the scribe of the captain of the army, who mustered the people of the land, and sixty men of the people of the land who were found in the city.

refs.text_gb: 护卫长尼布撒拉旦将这些人带到在利比拉的巴比伦王那里。
refs.text_big5: 護衛長尼布撒拉旦將這些人帶到在利比拉的巴比倫王那裏。
refs.text_en: And Nebuzaradan the captain of the bodyguard took them and brought them to the king of Babylon in Riblah.

refs.text_gb: 巴比伦王就击杀他们，在哈马地的利比拉把他们处死。这样，犹大人被迁徙离开了本地。
refs.text_big5: 巴比倫王就擊殺他們，在哈馬地的利比拉把他們處死。這樣，猶大人被遷徙離開了本地。
refs.text_en: And the king of Babylon struck them down and put them to death in Riblah, in the land of Hamath; so Judah was carried away into exile out of its land.

refs.text_gb: 巴比伦王的众首领，就是尼甲沙利薛、三甲尼波、太监长撒西金、总管星象家的尼甲沙利薛、并巴比伦王所有其余的首领，都来坐在中门。
refs.text_big5: 巴比倫王的眾首領，就是尼甲沙利薛、三甲尼波、太監長撒西金、總管星象家的尼甲沙利薛、並巴比倫王所有其餘的首領，都來坐在中門。
refs.text_en: All the princes of the king of Babylon came and sat down in the middle gate: Nergal-sharezer, Samgar-nebu, Sar-sechim the Rab-saris, Nergal-sharezer the Rab-mag, and all the rest of the princes of the king of Babylon.

refs.text_gb: 犹大王西底家和一切兵丁看见他们，就在夜间从王园的路，两城墙之间的门，出城逃跑，他沿着通往亚拉巴的路出去。
refs.text_big5: 猶大王西底家和一切兵丁看見他們，就在夜間從王園的路，兩城牆之間的門，出城逃跑，他沿著通往亞拉巴的路出去。
refs.text_en: And when Zedekiah the king of Judah and all the men of war saw them, they fled and went out from the city by night by way of the king's garden through the gate between the two walls; and he went out by the way toward the Arabah.

refs.text_gb: 迦勒底人的军队追赶他们，在耶利哥的平原追上西底家，将他拿住，带到哈马地的利比拉，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒那里；尼布甲尼撒就审判他。
refs.text_big5: 迦勒底人的軍隊追趕他們，在耶利哥的平原追上西底家，將他拿住，帶到哈馬地的利比拉，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒那裏；尼布甲尼撒就審判他。
refs.text_en: And the army of the Chaldeans pursued after them, and they overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and when they had taken him, they brought him up to Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath, and he pronounced judgments on him.

refs.text_gb: 巴比伦王在利比拉，西底家眼前杀了他的众子，又杀了犹大的一切贵胄。
refs.text_big5: 巴比倫王在利比拉，西底家眼前殺了他的眾子，又殺了猶大的一切貴胄。
refs.text_en: Then the king of Babylon slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes at Riblah; the king of Babylon also slaughtered all the nobles of Judah.

refs.text_gb: 并且剜了西底家的眼睛，用铜链锁着他，带到巴比伦去。
refs.text_big5: 並且剜了西底家的眼睛，用銅鍊鎖著他，帶到巴比倫去。
refs.text_en: And he put out Zedekiah's eyes and bound him with bronze fetters to bring him to Babylon.

refs.text_gb: 迦勒底人用火焚烧王宫和百姓的房屋，又拆毁耶路撒冷的城墙。
refs.text_big5: 迦勒底人用火焚燒王宮和百姓的房屋，又拆毀耶路撒冷的城牆。
refs.text_en: And the Chaldeans burned the king's house and the houses of the people with fire and broke down the walls of Jerusalem.

refs.text_gb: 那时护卫长尼布撒拉旦，将城里余剩的百姓，并投降他的人，以及其余的民，都迁徙到巴比伦去了。
refs.text_big5: 那時護衛長尼布撒拉旦，將城裏餘剩的百姓，並投降他的人，以及其餘的民，都遷徙到巴比倫去了。
refs.text_en: And the rest of the people who remained in the city, both the deserters who deserted to him and the rest of the people who remained, Nebuzaradan the captain of the bodyguard carried away into exile to Babylon.

refs.text_gb: 护卫长尼布撒拉旦却将民中毫无所有的穷人留在犹大地，当时给他们葡萄园和田地。
refs.text_big5: 護衛長尼布撒拉旦卻將民中毫無所有的窮人留在猶大地，當時給他們葡萄園和田地。
refs.text_en: But some of the poorest people who had nothing, Nebuzaradan the captain of the bodyguard left in the land of Judah and gave them vineyards and fields at that time.

verses.text_gb: 于是城被围困，直到西底家王十一年。
verses.text_big5: 於是城被圍困，直到西底家王十一年。
verses.text_en: So the city came under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

verses.text_gb: 四月初九日，城里饥荒严重，甚至那地的百姓都没有粮食。
verses.text_big5: 四月初九日，城裏饑荒嚴重，甚至那地的百姓都沒有糧食。
verses.text_en: In the fourth month, on the ninth day of the month, the famine was so severe within the city that there was no food for the people of the land.

verses.text_en: Then the city was breached, and all the men of war fled; and they went out from the city by night by way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king's garden, while the Chaldeans were all around the city; and they went by the way toward the Arabah.

refs.text_en: I will also spread My net over him, and he will be caught in My snare; and I will bring him to Babylon, the land of the Chaldeans, yet he will not see it and will die there.

refs.text_en: And they burned down the house of God; and they broke down the wall of Jerusalem and burned down all its palaces with fire, and all its precious vessels were given up to destruction.

refs.text_gb: 他们用火焚烧你的圣所，亵渎你名的住处，拆毁到地。

refs.text_gb: 他们对我说，那些被掳归回剩下的余民在犹大省遭大难，受凌辱；并且耶路撒冷的城墙被拆毁，城门被火焚烧。

refs.text_en: And they said to me, The remnant who are left from the captivity there in the province are in an exceedingly bad state and reproach, and the wall of Jerusalem is broken down and its gates have been burned with fire.

verses.text_gb: 那时护卫长尼布撒拉旦将民中最穷的，和城里所余剩的百姓，并已经投降巴比伦王的人，以及所余剩的群众，都迁[Cra]徙去了。

refs.text_big5: 巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒十九年五月初十日，在巴比倫王面前侍立的護衛長尼布撒拉旦來到耶路撒冷，
refs.text_en: And in the fifth month, on the tenth day of the month (this was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadrezzar, the king of Babylon), Nebuzaradan, the captain of the bodyguard, who stood before the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

verses.text_gb: 尼布甲尼撒二[Cra]十三年，护卫长尼布撒拉旦迁徙去犹大人七百四十五人；共有四千六百人。
verses.text_big5: 尼布甲尼撒二[Cra]十三年，護衛長尼布撒拉旦遷徙去猶大人七百四十五人；共有四千六百人。
verses.text_en: In the twenty-third year of Nebuchadrezzar, Nebuzaradan the captain of the bodyguard carried from the Jews seven hundred and forty-five persons into exile. There were four thousand six hundred persons in all.
verses.text_gb_plain: 尼布甲尼撒二十三年，护卫长尼布撒拉旦迁徙去犹大人七百四十五人；共有四千六百人。

refs.text_en: Thus says Jehovah of hosts, / They will thoroughly glean like a vine / The remnant of Israel; / Pass your hand again over the branches / Like a grape gatherer.

verses.text_en: And in the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Jehoiachin the king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-fifth of the month, Evil-merodach the king of Babylon, in the year that he became king, released Jehoiachin the king of Judah and brought him out of prison.

refs.text_gb: 又对他说恩慈的话，使他的位高过与他一同在巴比伦众王的位。

refs.text_en: And he spoke with him kindly and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Babylon.

refs.text_gb: 他换下囚服，终身常在巴比伦王面前吃饭。
refs.text_big5: 他換下囚服，終身常在巴比倫王面前喫飯。
refs.text_en: And Jehoiachin changed his prison clothes and ate his food in his presence continually all the days of his life.

refs.text_gb: 他所需用的食物，不断由王赐给，每日一分，终身都是这样。

refs.text_en: And for his allowance, a continual allowance was given to him by the king, a portion for each day, all the days of his life.
